s0201.literal: On jihai day an edict announcing the appointment of the right chancellor was issued throughout the realm.
s0201.idiomatic: On jihai day an edict announcing the appointment of the right chancellor was issued throughout the realm.

s0202.literal: Wandering refugees who returned to their occupations were exempted from corvée and tax for three years.
s0202.idiomatic: Wandering refugees who returned to their occupations were exempted from corvée and tax for 3 years.

s0203.literal: Relay households impoverished to the point of selling wives and children — the government redeemed and returned them.
s0203.idiomatic: Relay households impoverished to the point of selling wives and children — the government redeemed and returned them.

s0204.literal: For all corvée and construction levies, merchant, artisan, and wealthy households were assessed first, to spare agricultural labor.
s0204.idiomatic: For all corvée and construction levies, merchant, artisan, and wealthy households were assessed first, to spare agricultural labor.

s0205.literal: Thirty percent of next year's corvée and tax in Shaanxi was remitted, twenty percent of next year's rent on official tenant land everywhere, and the newly imposed bao silver levy in Jianghuai was entirely remitted.
s0205.idiomatic: 30% of next year's corvée and tax in Shaanxi was remitted, 20% of next year's rent on official tenant land everywhere, and the newly imposed bao silver levy in Jianghuai was entirely remitted.

s0206.literal: Censor Li Duan said, "Recently earthquakes in the capital and eclipses of the sun and moon are all due to our failure in office.
s0206.idiomatic: Censor Li Duan said, "Recently earthquakes in the capital and eclipses of the sun and moon are all due to our failure in office.

s0207.literal: " The Emperor blamed himself and said, "It is because my deliberations were inadequate that this has happened.
s0207.idiomatic: " The Emperor blamed himself and said, "It is because my deliberations were inadequate that this has happened.

s0208.literal: " An edict then directed that the officials too should discipline themselves, to heed Heaven's warning.
s0208.idiomatic: " An edict then directed that the officials too should discipline themselves, to heed Heaven's warning.

s0209.literal: Superfluous offices established since Emperor Shizu were abolished.
s0209.idiomatic: Superfluous offices established since Emperor Shizu were abolished.

s0210.literal: Jiangnan monks who had wives were registered as commoners.
s0210.idiomatic: Jiangnan monks who had wives were registered as commoners.

s0211.literal: Annam sent envoys presenting tribute goods; in return four hundred fifty taels of gold, nine gold coins, and silk in equal number were granted.
s0211.idiomatic: Annam sent envoys presenting tribute goods; in return 450 taels of gold, 9 gold coins, and silk in equal number were granted.

s0212.literal: On guimao day there was an earthquake.
s0212.idiomatic: On guimao day there was an earthquake.

s0213.literal: On jiachen day Venus encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.
s0213.idiomatic: On jiachen day Venus encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.

s0215.literal: On yisi day Mars encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.
s0215.idiomatic: On yisi day Mars encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.

s0216.literal: On bingwu day three dragon boats were built.
s0216.idiomatic: On bingwu day 3 dragon boats were built.

s0217.literal: On wushen day the moon masked Well.
s0217.idiomatic: On wushen day the moon masked Well.

s0218.literal: Min Prefecture suffered drought and epidemic; relief was granted, and gold belts were granted to wanhu, qianhu, and other officers garrisoning the northern frontier.
s0218.idiomatic: Min Prefecture suffered drought and epidemic; relief was granted, and gold belts were granted to wanhu, qianhu, and other officers garrisoning the northern frontier.

s0219.literal: Censor Li Duan said, "Although the court has established the Veritable Records of Attendance, what is recorded are only items that officials hear and memorialize.
s0219.idiomatic: Censor Li Duan said, "Although the court has established the Veritable Records of Attendance, what is recorded are only items that officials hear and memorialize.

s0220.literal: The sovereign's words and conduct should all be written and entrusted to the History Office.
s0220.idiomatic: The sovereign's words and conduct should all be written and entrusted to the History Office.

s0221.literal: Institutions fixed since Emperor Shizu should be codified as statutes, so officials cannot commit fraud and those adjudicating cases have rules to follow.
s0221.idiomatic: Institutions fixed since Emperor Shizu should be codified as statutes, so officials cannot commit fraud and those adjudicating cases have rules to follow.

s0223.literal: On yimao day the Western monk Gaozhuwa was dispatched to welcome the Imperial Preceptor.
s0223.idiomatic: On yimao day the Western monk Gaozhuwa was dispatched to welcome the Imperial Preceptor.

s0224.literal: In Xuande County of Xuande Prefecture the ground repeatedly shook; grain and notes were granted in relief to victims.
s0224.idiomatic: In Xuande County of Xuande Prefecture the ground repeatedly shook; grain and notes were granted in relief to victims.

s0225.literal: On jiwei day the moon encroached upon Eastern Door.
s0225.idiomatic: On jiwei day the moon encroached upon Eastern Door.

s0226.literal: Tuotuohesun was fixed to enter the regular official selection stream, with seal and salary granted.
s0226.idiomatic: Tuotuohesun was fixed to enter the regular official selection stream, with seal and salary granted.

s0227.literal: The Eight Tribes Military-Civilian Pacification Office was established, and twenty-eight chieftain jurisdictions were converted into prefectures and counties.
s0227.idiomatic: The Eight Tribes Military-Civilian Pacification Office was established, and 28 chieftain jurisdictions were converted into prefectures and counties.

s0228.literal: On gengshen day the moon encroached upon Celestial River.
s0228.idiomatic: On gengshen day the moon encroached upon Celestial River.

s0229.literal: On xinyou day Mars encroached upon Jupiter.
s0229.idiomatic: On xinyou day Mars encroached upon Jupiter.

s0230.literal: Perfected Master Cai Daitai killed a man and was executed;
s0230.idiomatic: Perfected Master Cai Daitai killed a man and was executed;

s0231.literal: Ministry of Justice director Budashili was convicted of accepting his gold, and Fan Deyu of collusive evasion — both were beaten and dismissed.
s0231.idiomatic: Ministry of Justice director Budashili was convicted of accepting his gold, and Fan Deyu of collusive evasion — both were beaten and dismissed.

s0232.literal: Pingjiang Circuit suffered flooding, damaging forty-nine thousand six hundred thirty qing of official and civilian land; rent was remitted.
s0232.idiomatic: Pingjiang Circuit suffered flooding, damaging 49,630 qing of official and civilian land; rent was remitted.

s0233.literal: Twelfth month, jiazi new moon: Jianchang Prefecture of Nankang suffered great flooding and landslides; forty-seven died and the people were famished; relief was ordered.
s0233.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiazi new moon: Jianchang Prefecture of Nankang suffered great flooding and landslides; 47 died and the people were famished; relief was ordered.

s0234.literal: On yichou day Venus, Jupiter, and Mars converged in Encampment; Venus encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.
s0234.idiomatic: On yichou day Venus, Jupiter, and Mars converged in Encampment; Venus encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.

s0235.literal: On dingmao day central secretariat grand councillor Mai Lü was dismissed and made director of the Central Domestic Affairs Court, Lian Xun was dismissed and made grand academician of the Hall of Worthies, and Hall of Worthies grand academician Zhang Gui was made central secretariat grand councillor.
s0235.idiomatic: On dingmao day central secretariat grand councillor Mai Lü was dismissed and made director of the Central Domestic Affairs Court, Lian Xun was dismissed and made grand academician of the Hall of Worthies, and Hall of Worthies grand academician Zhang Gui was made central secretariat grand councillor.

s0236.literal: On wuchen day Zhang Sicheng, Wu Quanjie, and Lan Daoyuan of the Taoist directorate, each thrice granted commissions and silver seals — an edict stripped two from each.
s0236.idiomatic: On wuchen day Zhang Sicheng, Wu Quanjie, and Lan Daoyuan of the Taoist directorate, each thrice granted commissions and silver seals — an edict stripped 2 from each.

s0237.literal: On renshen day the silver tax on Hui households garrisoned and settled in Hexi was remitted.
s0237.idiomatic: On renshen day the silver tax on Hui households garrisoned and settled in Hexi was remitted.

s0238.literal: On jiaxu day Laian Route chief commander Cen Shixing rebelled; troops were dispatched to suppress him.
s0238.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Laian Route chief commander Cen Shixing rebelled; troops were dispatched to suppress him.

s0239.literal: Tiemudie'er's son, Huizheng Court commissioner Basijisi, was convicted of accepting land falsely presented by Liu Kui and executed; his household property was confiscated.
s0239.idiomatic: Tiemudie'er's son, Huizheng Court commissioner Basijisi, was convicted of accepting land falsely presented by Liu Kui and executed; his household property was confiscated.

s0240.literal: On yihai day the moon masked Well.
s0240.idiomatic: On yihai day the moon masked Well.

s0241.literal: On bingyin day Prince Zhennan Tobuhua's garrison troops were increased.
s0241.idiomatic: On bingyin day Prince Zhennan Tobuhua's garrison troops were increased.

s0242.literal: On wuyin day Venus encroached upon Jupiter.
s0242.idiomatic: On wuyin day Venus encroached upon Jupiter.

s0243.literal: On gengchen day Ge Man Pacification Office vice commissioner Long Rengui rebelled; Huguang branch secretariat supervised troops to capture him.
s0243.idiomatic: On gengchen day Ge Man Pacification Office vice commissioner Long Rengui rebelled; Huguang branch secretariat supervised troops to capture him.

s0244.literal: Privy council director Qinchatai was made Huizheng Court commissioner, associate administering director Susu was made left secretariat vice director, and Zongren Guard privy guard commander Mara was made associate administering director.
s0244.idiomatic: Privy council director Qinchatai was made Huizheng Court commissioner, associate administering director Susu was made left secretariat vice director, and Zongren Guard privy guard commander Mara was made associate administering director.

s0245.literal: On guiwei day the cave barbarian Bazhe of Rouyuan Prefecture, Shaoxing Circuit, raided; troops were dispatched to capture him.
s0245.idiomatic: On guiwei day the cave barbarian Bazhe of Rouyuan Prefecture, Shaoxing Circuit, raided; troops were dispatched to capture him.

s0246.literal: Censor-in-chief Jirhalang was made privy council director.
s0246.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Jirhalang was made privy council director.

s0247.literal: Chochu Tu was enfeoffed as Prince of Wuning and granted a gold seal.
s0247.idiomatic: Chochu Tu was enfeoffed as Prince of Wuning and granted a gold seal.

s0248.literal: Because of the earthquake and solar eclipse, the central secretariat, privy council, censorate, Hanlin Academy, and Hall of Worthies were ordered to assemble and deliberate on matters of benefit and harm to the state and report.
s0248.idiomatic: Because of the earthquake and solar eclipse, the central secretariat, privy council, censorate, Hanlin Academy, and Hall of Worthies were ordered to assemble and deliberate on matters of benefit and harm to the state and report.

s0249.literal: An edict directed that construction at the two capitals remain as before; the rest as deliberated.
s0249.idiomatic: An edict directed that construction at the two capitals remain as before; the rest as deliberated.

s0250.literal: The liquor prohibition in Henan, Shaanxi, and other places was relaxed.
s0250.idiomatic: The liquor prohibition in Henan, Shaanxi, and other places was relaxed.

s0251.literal: Close attendants memorializing to take confiscated goods and funds was forbidden.
s0251.idiomatic: Close attendants memorializing to take confiscated goods and funds was forbidden.

s0252.literal: On yiyou day Hangzhou suffered fire; relief was granted.
s0252.idiomatic: On yiyou day Hangzhou suffered fire; relief was granted.

s0253.literal: On bingxu day the posthumous title of the Grand Empress Dowager was fixed as Zhaoxian Yuansheng; Court of Imperial Sacrifices commissioner Duotai was dispatched to announce the posthumous deliberation at the Grand Ancestral Temple.
s0253.idiomatic: On bingxu day the posthumous title of the Grand Empress Dowager was fixed as Zhaoxian Yuansheng; Court of Imperial Sacrifices commissioner Duotai was dispatched to announce the posthumous deliberation at the Grand Ancestral Temple.

s0254.literal: Ningchang Prefecture was promoted to lower-route status and one county was added.
s0254.idiomatic: Ningchang Prefecture was promoted to lower-route status and 1 county was added.

s0255.literal: Xisha County of Yunnan was merged into Ning Prefecture.
s0255.idiomatic: Xisha County of Yunnan was merged into Ning Prefecture.

s0256.literal: Twenty qing of sacrificial estate for the shrine of Loyal and Martial King Bayan of Huai'an was granted.
s0256.idiomatic: 20 qing of sacrificial estate for the shrine of Loyal and Martial King Bayan of Huai'an was granted.

s0257.literal: On jichou day Mars encroached upon Outer Screen; the moon encroached upon Establishment.
s0257.idiomatic: On jichou day Mars encroached upon Outer Screen; the moon encroached upon Establishment.

s0258.literal: On xinmao day grain and notes were granted to Mongol refugees and they were sent back to their original territories.
s0258.idiomatic: On xinmao day grain and notes were granted to Mongol refugees and they were sent back to their original territories.

s0259.literal: Zhang Gui, ill with foot disease, was exempted from court congratulations.
s0259.idiomatic: Zhang Gui, ill with foot disease, was exempted from court congratulations.

s0260.literal: A Western monk, ill with an abhiseka ailment, requested release of prisoners; the Emperor said, "Releasing prisoners to seek blessing — how could it be that I begrudge this for the master's sake?
s0260.idiomatic: A Western monk, ill with an abhiseka ailment, requested release of prisoners; the Emperor said, "Releasing prisoners to seek blessing — how could it be that I begrudge this for the master's sake?

s0261.literal: I think that if wicked men are repeatedly pardoned they will in turn harm the good — where is the blessing in that?
s0261.idiomatic: I think that if wicked men are repeatedly pardoned they will in turn harm the good — where is the blessing in that?

s0262.literal: " Huixuan Court officials said, "In Emperor Shizu's time Huangjila annually supplied two thousand sheep to the imperial kitchen; under Emperor Chengzong it was raised to three thousand; now they request raising it to five thousand.
s0262.idiomatic: " Huixuan Court officials said, "In Emperor Shizu's time Huangjila annually supplied 2,000 sheep to the imperial kitchen; under Emperor Chengzong it was raised to 3,000; now they request raising it to 5,000.

s0263.literal: The Emperor did not approve and said, "All the people under Heaven belong to me; if there is insufficiency I should succor them.
s0263.idiomatic: The Emperor did not approve and said, "All the people under Heaven belong to me; if there is insufficiency I should succor them.

s0264.literal: If levies are increased the common people will surely be driven to destitution — what benefit is there for the state?
s0264.idiomatic: If levies are increased the common people will surely be driven to destitution — what benefit is there for the state?

s0265.literal: " An edict ordered observance of Emperor Shizu's old regulations.
s0265.idiomatic: " An edict ordered observance of Emperor Shizu's old regulations.

s0266.literal: Huizhou, Luzhou, Jinan, Zhending, Hejian, Daming, Guide, Runing, Gongchang and other places and Henan's Shaobo garrison farm suffered flooding; Datong, Weihui, Jiangling subordinate counties and the Dahui garrison of Fengshan Office suffered wind; Henan and Yunnan's Wumeng and other garrison farms suffered drought; Bianliang, Shunde, Hejian, Baoding, Qingyuan, Jining, Puzhou, Yidu subordinate counties and various guard garrison farms suffered locusts.
s0266.idiomatic: Huizhou, Luzhou, Jinan, Zhending, Hejian, Daming, Guide, Runing, Gongchang and other places and Henan's Shaobo garrison farm suffered flooding; Datong, Weihui, Jiangling subordinate counties and the Dahui garrison of Fengshan Office suffered wind; Henan and Yunnan's Wumeng and other garrison farms suffered drought; Bianliang, Shunde, Hejian, Baoding, Qingyuan, Jining, Puzhou, Yidu subordinate counties and various guard garrison farms suffered locusts.

s0267.literal: Third year, first month, guisi new moon: Siam and Eight Tribes cave barbarian chieftains each dispatched envoys presenting tribute.
s0267.idiomatic: Third year, first month, guisi new moon: Siam and Eight Tribes cave barbarian chieftains each dispatched envoys presenting tribute.

s0268.literal: Yucheng County of Cao Prefecture — last autumn's rains harmed the crops; county residents Xing Zhu and Cheng Jin contributed grain to relieve the hungry; the relevant office was ordered to honor their gates.
s0268.idiomatic: Yucheng County of Cao Prefecture — last autumn's rains harmed the crops; county residents Xing Zhu and Cheng Jin contributed grain to relieve the hungry; the relevant office was ordered to honor their gates.

s0269.literal: On yiwei day sacrifice was performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.
s0269.idiomatic: On yiwei day sacrifice was performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.

s0270.literal: On jihai day bandits rose in Siming Prefecture; Huguang branch secretariat supervised troops to capture them.
s0270.idiomatic: On jihai day bandits rose in Siming Prefecture; Huguang branch secretariat supervised troops to capture them.

s0271.literal: On gengzi day Ministry of Justice director Wuma'er was convicted of corruption, beaten and dismissed.
s0271.idiomatic: On gengzi day Ministry of Justice director Wuma'er was convicted of corruption, beaten and dismissed.

s0272.literal: On renyin day the Court of the Imperial Stud was ordered to supply an additional one hundred mares for mare's-milk sacrifice at the spirit halls of Emperors Shizu and Renzong.
s0272.idiomatic: On renyin day the Court of the Imperial Stud was ordered to supply an additional 100 mares for mare's-milk sacrifice at the spirit halls of Emperors Shizu and Renzong.

s0273.literal: Relay households of Karakorum, Alantu, and elsewhere were impoverished; notes were granted in relief.
s0273.idiomatic: Relay households of Karakorum, Alantu, and elsewhere were impoverished; notes were granted in relief.

s0274.literal: Branch secretariat grand councillors were again made concurrently commander of military affairs; military officers guilty of offenses — serious cases reported upward, minor ones decided on the spot.
s0274.idiomatic: Branch secretariat grand councillors were again made concurrently commander of military affairs; military officers guilty of offenses — serious cases reported upward, minor ones decided on the spot.

s0275.literal: Gold and silver smelters at Shangdu, Yun Prefecture, Xinghe, Xuande, Yu Prefecture, Fengsheng Prefecture, Jiming Mountain, Fang Mountain, Huanglu, Sancha and elsewhere were abolished; commoners were permitted to mine and smelt, remitting three-tenths to the government.
s0275.idiomatic: Gold and silver smelters at Shangdu, Yun Prefecture, Xinghe, Xuande, Yu Prefecture, Fengsheng Prefecture, Jiming Mountain, Fang Mountain, Huanglu, Sancha and elsewhere were abolished; commoners were permitted to mine and smelt, remitting 3/10 to the government.

s0276.literal: Former privy council vice director Wu Yuangui and Wang Yue were granted Hall of Worthies grand academician rank, Hanlin expositor Han Congyi was granted Zhaowen Hall grand academician rank — all to deliberate on central secretariat affairs.
s0276.idiomatic: Former privy council vice director Wu Yuangui and Wang Yue were granted Hall of Worthies grand academician rank, Hanlin expositor Han Congyi was granted Zhaowen Hall grand academician rank — all to deliberate on central secretariat affairs.

s0277.literal: Bayan said, "Former Hall of Worthies expositor Zhao Juxin and academicians-direct Wu Cheng are both virtuous elder Confucians; I request they be summoned and employed.
s0277.idiomatic: Bayan said, "Former Hall of Worthies expositor Zhao Juxin and academicians-direct Wu Cheng are both virtuous elder Confucians; I request they be summoned and employed.

s0278.literal: The Emperor was pleased and said, "Your words exactly match my mind; we should further seek out recluses hidden in mountains and forests.
s0278.idiomatic: The Emperor was pleased and said, "Your words exactly match my mind; we should further seek out recluses hidden in mountains and forests.

s0279.literal: " Zhao Juxin was thereupon made Hanlin academician-expositor-in-chief and Wu Cheng made academician.
s0279.idiomatic: " Zhao Juxin was thereupon made Hanlin academician-expositor-in-chief and Wu Cheng made academician.

s0280.literal: Two additional judges were added to the Shangdu rear-guard office, to be Han Chinese, exclusively handling penal matters.
s0280.idiomatic: Two additional judges were added to the Shangdu rear-guard office, to be Han Chinese, exclusively handling penal matters.

s0281.literal: Two intendant offices for Empress Renzong's palace rank were established at fifth grade, subordinate to the Chenghui Temple.
s0281.idiomatic: Two intendant offices for Empress Renzong's palace rank were established at fifth grade, subordinate to the Chenghui Temple.

s0282.literal: The moon encroached upon Halberd, and again encroached upon Well.
s0282.idiomatic: The moon encroached upon Halberd, and again encroached upon Well.

s0283.literal: On guimao day the moon encroached upon Well.
s0283.idiomatic: On guimao day the moon encroached upon Well.

s0284.literal: On jiachen day Prince Zhenxi Wuning's following suffered famine; relief was granted.
s0284.idiomatic: On jiachen day Prince Zhenxi Wuning's following suffered famine; relief was granted.

s0285.literal: Prince Hulachu was dispatched to garrison Yunnan and granted fifteen thousand ingots of notes.
s0285.idiomatic: Prince Hulachu was dispatched to garrison Yunnan and granted 15,000 ingots of notes.

s0286.literal: On xinhai day Tieshi was again ordered to invigorate the censorate framework.
s0286.idiomatic: On xinhai day Tieshi was again ordered to invigorate the censorate framework.

s0287.literal: On renzi day a princes' relay station was built in the capital; Muslim artillery wanhu were dispatched to Runing and Xincai to teach artillery methods per Emperor Shizu's old regulations.
s0287.idiomatic: On renzi day a princes' relay station was built in the capital; Muslim artillery wanhu were dispatched to Runing and Xincai to teach artillery methods per Emperor Shizu's old regulations.

s0288.literal: The Liao of Jingjiang, Yong, and Liu prefectures raided; Huguang branch secretariat was ordered to supervise troops to capture them.
s0288.idiomatic: The Liao of Jingjiang, Yong, and Liu prefectures raided; Huguang branch secretariat was ordered to supervise troops to capture them.

s0289.literal: On jiayin day because the Zongren Guard's quota of Mongol children was sufficient for ten thousand households, collection was ordered stopped.
s0289.idiomatic: On jiayin day because the Zongren Guard's quota of Mongol children was sufficient for 10,000 households, collection was ordered stopped.

s0290.literal: On yimao day households of the Eastern Expedition's Mojidi Wuze presented sable, otter, and seal skins; an edict granted three years' relief and care.
s0290.idiomatic: On yimao day households of the Eastern Expedition's Mojidi Wuze presented sable, otter, and seal skins; an edict granted 3 years' relief and care.

s0291.literal: On bingchen day Quanzhou commoner Liu Yingzong rebelled; Jiangzhe branch secretariat was ordered to dispatch troops to capture him.
s0291.idiomatic: On bingchen day Quanzhou commoner Liu Yingzong rebelled; Jiangzhe branch secretariat was ordered to dispatch troops to capture him.

s0292.literal: On dingsi day ranks for posthumous enfeoffment and office grants were fixed.
s0292.idiomatic: On dingsi day ranks for posthumous enfeoffment and office grants were fixed.

s0293.literal: On xinyou day falsely killing descendants to frame commoners was forbidden.
s0293.idiomatic: On xinyou day falsely killing descendants to frame commoners was forbidden.

s0294.literal: One additional Ministry of War director was added.
s0294.idiomatic: One additional Ministry of War director was added.

s0295.literal: Sichuan branch secretariat grand councillor Zhao Shiyan, because his younger brother sued him over unlawful conduct, was imprisoned awaiting response; his brother fled; an edict released him.
s0295.idiomatic: Sichuan branch secretariat grand councillor Zhao Shiyan, because his younger brother sued him over unlawful conduct, was imprisoned awaiting response; his brother fled; an edict released him.

s0296.literal: It was also codified as a statute: if the fugitive did not appear within one hundred days, the one awaiting response was released.
s0296.idiomatic: It was also codified as a statute: if the fugitive did not appear within 100 days, the one awaiting response was released.

s0297.literal: Privy council vice director Wanyan Nadan, attendant censor Cao Boqi, yeke jarquchi Buyan, Hall of Worthies academician Qincha, and Hanlin academician-direct Cao Yuanyong were ordered to hear read the accumulated dynastic regulations compiled in Emperor Renzong's time.
s0297.idiomatic: Privy council vice director Wanyan Nadan, attendant censor Cao Boqi, yeke jarquchi Buyan, Hall of Worthies academician Qincha, and Hanlin academician-direct Cao Yuanyong were ordered to hear read the accumulated dynastic regulations compiled in Emperor Renzong's time.

s0298.literal: Edict: "For those exceptionally appointed outside the regular roster, only raise their office, do not raise their grade."
s0298.idiomatic: Edict: "For those exceptionally appointed outside the regular roster, only raise their office, do not raise their grade."

s0299.literal: Second month, guihai new moon: Huayan Temple, Imperial Preceptor 'Phags-pa Temple, and Bayan's mansion at Shangdu were built, employing six thousand two hundred soldiers.
s0299.idiomatic: Second month, guihai new moon: Huayan Temple, Imperial Preceptor 'Phags-pa Temple, and Bayan's mansion at Shangdu were built, employing 6,200 soldiers.

s0300.literal: Military officer hereditary succession was regulated: when the eldest legitimate son or grandson was young, brothers and nephews were to act in his stead with a provisional commission bearing the appointment patent, to quell lawsuits.
s0300.idiomatic: Military officer hereditary succession was regulated: when the eldest legitimate son or grandson was young, brothers and nephews were to act in his stead with a provisional commission bearing the appointment patent, to quell lawsuits.
